sections.text: AN IMPRESSIVE AND UNSEASONABLE FAST-MOVING SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE ESEWD FROM THE NRN PLAINS INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY TODAY. AHEAD OF THE SYSTEM...A MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS WILL BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE MID TO UPPER MS VALLEY EXTENDING EWD INTO THE OH AND TN VALLEYS. THIS SETUP WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR A SIGNIFICANT WIND DAMAGE EVENT ACROSS PARTS OF THE UPPER MS VALLEY...SRN GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. AT THE SFC...A WARM FRONT IS FORECAST TO SETUP FROM NRN IL INTO CNTRL IND DURING THE DAY WITH A WNW-ESE ORIENTED SHARP GRADIENT OF INSTABILITY LOCATED ALONG THE FRONT. A BAND OF CONVECTION MAY BE ONGOING NEAR OR JUST TO THE SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT FROM IA SEWD INTO CNTRL IL AT THE START OF THE PERIOD. THIS CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO MOVE SEWD INTO THE OH RIVER VALLEY AND MAY HAVE AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. AS A MODERATELY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR DEVELOPS BACK TO THE WEST ACROSS THE MID TO UPPER MS VALLEY...AN ASSOCIATED 60 TO 75 KT MID-LEVEL JET WILL APPROACH THE REGION FROM THE WEST. THE PROGRESSIVE MID-LEVEL JET WILL ENHANCE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AND STRENGTHEN DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY MAKING CONDITIONS FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STOR

sections.text: BELT OF STRONGER WLYS WILL PERSIST ACROSS THE NRN TIER STATES INCLUDING THE GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EMBEDDED WITHIN THIS BELT OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT WILL MOVE FROM NRN ND THIS MORNING TO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES THIS EVENING. SEVERAL SMALLER SCALE MCVS ARE EVIDENT OVER THE MID-UPPER MS VALLEY AND WILL ADVANCE SEWD. A COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM THE LOW SWWD THROUGH SWRN NEB INTO NERN CO. THE WARM FRONT WILL MOVE NWD INTO NRN IL TODAY AS THE SFC LOW DEVELOPS EWD INTO ERN IA LATER THIS AFTERNOON. ...UPPER MS VALLEY/SRN GREAT LAKES/OH VALLEY AND CNTRL APPALACHIANS... ONGOING STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO WEAKEN AS THEY SHIFT SEWD THIS MORNING...ALLOWING THE CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED WARM FRONT TO BEGIN TO MOVE NEWD IN RESPONSE TO A STRONG SWLY LLJ. PARTICULARLY GIVEN THIS MCV...AS THE DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS DESTABILIZES...AT LEAST LIKELY ADDITIONAL MCS/MCV-PRECEDING DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR ASIDE FROM A GENERAL INTENSIFICATION...WITH BOUTS OF SEVERE WIND/POSSIBLY SOME HAIL THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY EWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY
sections.text: RECENT SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES THE SURFACE LOW OVER W-CNTRL IA WITH A WEAK INVERTED TROUGH EXTENDING NWD TO ANOTHER LOW NEAR THE ND/SD/MN BORDER INTERSECTION. WARM FRONT EXTENDS FROM THE W-CNTRL IA LOW ENEWD INTO FAR NE IA AND THEN SEWD ACROSS CNTRL IL TO NEAR CMI IN E-CNTRL IL. THIS BOUNDARY HAS BEEN REINFORCED BY DIFFERENTIAL HEATING WITH CLEAR SKIES AND TEMPERATURES IN 80S TO ITS SOUTH WHILE PARTLY TO MOSTLY CLOUDY AND TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 70S TO ITS NORTH. THIS BOUNDARY IS EXPECTED TO MOVE GRADUALLY NEWD OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AND TO ACT AS THE NRN DELIMITER OF THE MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR RISK. 19Z SOUNDING FROM ILX SAMPLED 13 DEG C AT 700 MB AND THE RESULTING CAP SHOULD LIMIT CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL SOUTH AND WEST OF CNTRL IL WITH NO NEED TO EXPAND ANY SEVERE PROBABILITIES SWWD. 19Z SOUNDING FROM DVN SAMPLED FAIRLY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES BUT SIGNIFICANT WARMING AROUND 850 MB /ABOUT 5 DEG C SINCE 12Z/ HAS KEPT CONVECTIVE-INHIBITION IN PLACE. CONTINUED WARMING AND MOISTENING ARE ANTICIPATED HERE AS THE AIRMASS TO THE SW /CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW 90S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S/ CONTINUES TO ADVECT NEWD. sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: PRIOR FORECAST REASONING AND EXPECTATIONS FOR EVOLUTION OF CONVECTION FOR THE REMAINDER OF THE PERIOD REMAIN VALID...WITH A LARGE/EVOLVING CLUSTER OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS NOW CROSSING NRN IL. THIS BAND OF STORMS -- AND ASSOCIATED CELLS CROSSING SRN LK MI...SWRN LOWER MI..AND NWRN OH -- WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT WITHIN BACKGROUND FLOW FIELD FEATURING 40 TO 60 KT WNWLYS ALOFT...AND THROUGH AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY LYING ACROSS THE AREA. FARTHER NW...A SMALLER CLUSTER OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS IS ONGOING OVER PARTS OF ERN/SRN MN...WHICH SHOULD MOVE INTO PARTS OF WRN WI AND POSSIBLY NERN IA OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. ALONG WITH RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES -- MAINLY OVER THE NRN IL VICINITY...WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN LIKELY ACROSS THE MIDWEST/OH VALLEY REGION. LINGERING CONVECTION -- AND LOCAL WIND RISK -- MAY EXTEND AS FAR SEWD AS WRN MD...CENTRAL VA/...AND N CENTRAL NC BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. ..GOSS.. 06/23/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: UNCERTAINTIES REMAIN CONCERNING CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION AND SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF THUNDERSTORM INTENSIFICATION AND ORGANIZATION THAT COULD BE ACCOMPANIED BY AN INCREASING RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL AREA OF SUSTAINED VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO PROGRESS SOUTH THROUGH SOUTHEAST OF THE JACKSON KY AREA. THIS CONVECTION HAS PROBABLY BEEN SUPPORTED BY AN AREA OF ENHANCED FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK MID-LEVEL SHORT WAVE IMPULSE. THE STRENGTH AND PERSISTENCE OF THIS FORCING REMAINS UNCLEAR. HOWEVER...STORMS ARE DEVELOPING SOUTHEASTWARD INTO A MOIST AND DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS THE WESTERN SLOPES OF THE CENTRAL/SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS...WHERE CAPE NOW APPEARS AS LARGE AS 1500-2000 J/KG. ADDITIONAL NEW THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE INITIATING NEAR THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/EFFECTIVE WARM FRONTAL ZONE TRAILING WEST NORTHWESTWARD TOWARD THE OHIO RIVER...NEAR OWENSBORO KY. NEAR AND WEST OF THE OHIO RIVER...VERY WARM AIR ALOFT EMERGING FROM THE PLAINS PROBABLY WILL CAP ANY ATTEMPTS AT STORM DEVELOPMENT. ACROSS SOUTHERN KENTUCKY/NORTHERN TENNESSEE...INTO THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS...MODERATE TO LARGE CAPE AND WEAKER/WEAKENING INHIBITION PROVIDE POTENTIAL FOR CONSIDERABLE FURTHER INCREASE AND INTENSIFICATION OF THUNDERSTORMS THROUGH 18-21Z. ON THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF A BELT OF SEASONABLY STRONG WEST NORTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW /30-50 KT AT 500 MB/...THE GRADUAL EVOLUTION OF AN UPSCALE GROWING ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION. IF/WHEN THIS OCCURS...THE ENVIRONMENT APPEARS SUPPORTIVE OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CONVECTIVELY GENERATED SURFACE COLD POOL...ACCOMPANIED BY POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AT LEAST APPROACHING...IF NOT EXCEEDING SEVERE LIMITS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY 23Z. THESE STORMS WILL QUICKLY BECOME SEVERE WITH TORNADOES...DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE INTO THE EVENING HOURS. A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR FOR PORTIONS OF THE MCD AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION DURING MOST OF THE MORNING HOURS AND RELATED CLOUD COVER ACROSS IA/WI/IL/IND HAS RESULTED IN MAINTENANCE OF STRONG CAPPING /AS EVIDENT IN 19Z REGIONAL RAOBS/. HOWEVER...RECENT CLEARING IN THE LAST 1-2 HOURS HAS ALLOWED FOR STRONG SURFACE HEATING WITH TEMPERATURES CLIMBING FROM THE UPPER 60S F INTO THE MID 70S TO LOW 80S F AS FAR NORTH AS THE IL/WI BORDER. ADDITIONAL HEATING AND MOISTENING SHOULD CONTINUE TO ERODE THE CAP. AS DEEP LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT INCREASES WITH THE APPROACH OF THE UPPER SHORTWAVE IMPULSE...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS ERN IA/SW WI/FAR NW IL BY 23Z. ONCE STORMS DEVELOP...THEY ARE EXPECTED TO TRACK E-SE ALONG A STRONG INSTABILITY GRADIENT IN THE VICINITY OF A WARM FRONT DRAPED ACROSS NRN IL INTO CENTRAL IND. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR 7.5 C/KM PER DVN AND ILX 19Z RAOBS AND 0-6 KM SHEAR GREATER THAN 50 KT WILL SUPPORT ROTATING UPDRAFTS AND LARGE HAIL. FURTHERMORE...RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE WITH MIXING RATIOS NEAR 14 G/KG AND BACKED LOW-LEVEL WINDS EVIDENT IN 19Z RAOBS AND...MORE RECENTLY...INDICATED BY REGIONAL VWP/S...WILL SUPPORT A FEW TORNADOES /POTENTIALLY ONE OR TWO SIG TORS/. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO GROW UPSCALE INTO A SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATING MCS WITH A COINCIDENT INCREASE IN DAMAGING WIND THREAT INTO INDIANA...AND LATER TONIGHT THE OHIO VALLEY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: COVERAGE OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN RATHER SPARSE...BUT ONE OR TWO STORMS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY A SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTH CAROLINA AND VIRGINIA PIEDMONT INTO COASTAL PLAIN LATE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED 50 KT WEST NORTHWESTERLY 500 MB JET STREAK ARE IN THE PROCESS OF CROSSING THE CENTRAL/SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS REGION. ASSOCIATED FORCING FOR ASCENT PROBABLY HAS AIDED THE INITIATION OF ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS THE PIEDMONT OF NORTH CAROLINA INTO SOUTHERN VIRGINIA. LOW-LEVEL LIFT APPEARS GENERALLY WEAK/UNFOCUSED ACROSS THIS REGION...BUT INSOLATION HAS CONTRIBUTED TO FAIRLY DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER MIXING AND AT LEAST MODEST BOUNDARY LAYER CAPE /1500+ J PER KG/...IN THE PRESENCE OF STRENGTHENING VERTICAL SHEAR. ONE OR TWO STORMS COULD STILL INTENSIFY FURTHER THROUGH 22-23Z...WITH A SUSTAINED SUPERCELL NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION. GIVEN SIZABLE LOW-LEVEL TEMPERATURE/DEW POINT SPREADS...LOCALLY STRONG SURFACE GUSTS MAY BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT...WITH MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE AS ACTIVITY SPREADS ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE PIEDMONT TOWARD THE COASTAL PLAIN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED...AND RELATIVELY DISORGANIZED CONVECTION CONTINUES ACROSS CENTRAL MINNESOTA. AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT WILL PERSIST WITH THIS ACTIVITY. A WW IS NOT LIKELY ATTM...BUT MAY BECOME NECESSARY IF MORE THAN ONE OR TWO SEVERE STORMS CAN EMERGE FROM CURRENT ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED CONVECTION CONTINUES IN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE INSTABILITY /1500-2500 J/KG MUCAPE...HIGHER WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT/ AND ABOUT 55-65 KNOTS OF DEEP SHEAR. THESE STORMS HAVE BEEN A BIT SLOW TO ORGANIZE THIS AFTERNOON...ALTHOUGH LATEST RADAR/LIGHTNING DATA SUGGESTS AN INCREASE IN INTENSITY ALONG THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THIS ACTIVITY...PARTICULARLY IN RENVILLE AND MEEKER COUNTIES IN MINNESOTA. THIS ACTIVITY IS LIKELY INFLUENCED BY BOTH A SURFACE BOUNDARY OVER CENTRAL MINNESOTA AND AN APPROACHING MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE NOW CENTERED OVER FAR NORTHWESTERN MINNESOTA. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGEST THAT ONE OR TWO OF THESE CELLS MAY BECOME DOMINANT WITH EASTWARD/SOUTHEASTWARD PROGRESSION ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...MOST LIKELY IN SOUTHERN/SOUTHEASTERN MINNESOTA. IF THIS SCENARIO UNFOLDS AS THE GUIDANCE SUGGESTS...ISOLATED HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE DOMINANT STORMS. A TORNADO CANNOT BE COMPLETELY RULED OUT GIVEN SUBTLE LOW-LEVEL BOUNDARIES IN THE REGION...ALTHOUGH WEAK LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELDS SHOULD TEMPER THIS THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED HAIL THREAT WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS MAINLY SOUTHWEST AND SOUTH-CENTRAL LOWER MI...AND PERHAPS FAR NORTHEAST INDIANA AND FAR NORTHWEST OH AS ELEVATED STORMS DEVELOPING OVER FAR SOUTHEAST WI AND ACROSS SOUTHERN LAKE MI TRACK TO THE SOUTHEAST THIS EVENING. LIMITED SEVERE STORM COVERAGE PRECLUDES THE NEED FOR A WATCH AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN EARLY EVENING MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED A CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS EXTENDING FROM EXTREME SOUTHEAST WI E/SE ACROSS SOUTHERN LAKE MI...WITH A STORM OVER THE LAKE /APPROXIMATELY AT 35 NW BEH/ HAVING INDICATED POSSIBLE HAIL AROUND 1 INCH IN DIAMETER PER MRMS DATA. STORMS ONGOING IN FAR SOUTHWEST LOWER MI INTO NORTHEAST INDIANA HAVE TENDED TO BE WEAK. THIS WOULD SUGGEST THIS ACTIVITY MAY BE SURFACE-BASED GIVEN PRESENCE OF WEAK INSTABILITY. MEANWHILE...THE STRONGER STORMS LOCATED ACROSS SOUTHERN LAKE MI APPEAR TO BEING FED BY A 40-KT SOUTHWESTERLY LOW-LEVEL JET IN NORTHEAST IL PER AREA VWPS...WITH THE STRONGER INSTABILITY IN IL. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-45 KT ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA WILL SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION...WITH THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO THREAT AND POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUE ACROSS THE VALID PORTION OF WW 286 IN MUCH OF NORTHERN ILLINOIS AND NORTHWEST INDIANA. THROUGH 03Z...THE GREATEST THREAT FOR STRONG TORNADOES SHOULD PERSIST ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL IL WITH THE ONGOING CLUSTER OF STORMS AS THEY TRACK TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST NEAR THE WARM FRONT. A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED THIS EVENING FOR A TORNADO THREAT AND AN INCREASING SEVERE/DAMAGING WIND THREAT DOWNSTREAM OF WW 286.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN EARLY EVENING MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A CLUSTER OF SUPERCELLS...SOME TORNADIC...TRACKING TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST AT 25-30 KT...WITH THE GREATEST TORNADO THREAT EXPECTED TO REMAIN 20-25 MILES EITHER SIDE OF THE WARM FRONT. AT 00-01Z...THIS FRONT EXTENDED FROM A SURFACE LOW IN SOUTHEAST IA THROUGH THE COMPLEX OF SUPERCELLS IN NORTHERN IL TO CENTRAL INDIANA AND THEN TENDS TO BECOME MORE DIFFUSE ACROSS CENTRAL OH. LOW-LEVEL WINDS ACROSS IL/INDIANA HAVE STRENGTHENED FROM THE SOUTHWEST AT 30-40 KT WITH 0-KM SRH INCREASING /ILX WSR-88D VWP 0-1 KM SRH 300+ M2/S2 AT 0124Z/. THIS LLJ IS ALSO PROVIDING A FEED OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 2500-4000 J PER KG/...WHILE THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT EXTENDED SOUTHEAST INTO CENTRAL INDIANA AND SOUTHWEST OHIO. AND...THE STRENGTHENING SWLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE AIDING IN THE RETURN OF HIGHER SURFACE DEW POINTS ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR /INTO CENTRAL INDIANA AND SOUTHWEST TO CENTRAL OHIO/. THIS DESTABILIZATION SUGGESTS THE TRACK OF AN EVENTUAL FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS/BOW WILL MOVE THROUGH CENTRAL INDIANA LATER THIS EVENING AND INTO WESTERN/CENTRAL OHIO OVERNIGHT. A VEERING AND FURTHER STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET TO 50-55 KT COMBINED WITH THE INFLUX OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY TO THE UPSCALE GROWING MCS WILL RESULT IN AN INCREASE IN THE FORWARD SPEED...GREATLY ENHANCING THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD SOUTHEAST ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA THIS EVENING. THE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED ENOUGH TO PRECLUDE A WW ISSUANCE...ALTHOUGH TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT PERSISTS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA ATTM...PARTICULARLY WITH RIGHT-MOVING SUPERCELLS THAT HAVE EVOLVED OVER DODGE AND STEELE COUNTIES IN MINNESOTA. THESE STORMS ARE MOVING SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD ALONG AN INSTABILITY GRADIENT...WHICH HAS LIKELY CONTRIBUTED TO THEIR INCREASE IN ROTATION OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. THEY REMAIN PRIMARILY NON-TORNADIC AND OUTFLOW-DOMINANT...ALTHOUGH 3 INCH HAIL WAS REPORTED IN RICE COUNTY WITH THIS ACTIVITY EARLIER. ISOLATED INSTANCES OF HAIL /PERHAPS SIGNIFICANT/ AND DAMAGING WIND MAY CONTINUE WITH THE STRONGEST OF THE STORMS FOR THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. BEYOND 03Z...THE COMBINATION OF RELATIVELY MEAGER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER COOLING SUGGESTS THAT A WEAKENING TREND SHOULD COMMENCE WITH ANY SURFACE-BASED ACTIVITY. ALTHOUGH ISOLATED ELEVATED STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE AFTER DARK...THE DEEPEST LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE SHOULD REMAIN DISPLACED WELL SOUTHEAST OF ONGOING ACTIVITY AND CONVERGENCE SHOULD BE RELATIVELY WEAK IN THE DISCUSSION AREA. THIS SHOULD RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT SPATIAL COVERAGE FOR A WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE VALID PORTION OF WW 286 IN NORTHEAST TO EAST-CENTRAL IL /SOUTH OF CHICAGO/ AND ACROSS WW 287. IN ADDITION...A DRAMATIC INCREASE IN FORWARD SPEED /50-55 KT TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST/ OF A BOWING STRUCTURE IN NORTHWEST INDIANA /WHITE...NORTHERN TIPPECANOE AND WESTERN CARROLL COUNTIES AS OF 0415Z/ WILL RESULT IN AN INCREASED SEVERE/DAMAGING WIND THREAT /GUSTS TO 70 KT/ ACROSS WW 287. BY 06Z...THESE DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO REACH THE AREA FROM INDIANAPOLIS TO MUNCIE INDIANA...AND THEN INTO SOUTHWEST OH /FROM BUTLER COUNTY TO AROUND DAYTON BETWEEN 07-08Z. DAMAGING WINDS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE ACROSS PARTS OF NORTHERN INDIANA INTO NORTHWEST TO CENTRAL OH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE BOWING STORM STRUCTURE IN NORTHWEST INDIANA WAS MOVING TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST AT 50-55 KT. WSR-88D CHICAGO RADAR INDICATED AN INTENSE AND DEEP REAR-INFLOW JET WITH THIS BOW /WITH SPEEDS OF 80-100 KT FROM THE LOWEST GATE TO 25 KFT AGL/. AROUND 0428Z...A MEASURED WIND GUST OF 87 MPH WAS OBSERVED 5 SE LAFAYETTE INDIANA WITH THIS BOW STRUCTURE. EXPANSIVE CLOUD-TOP COOLING CONTINUES ACROSS NORTHEAST AND EAST-CENTRAL IL INTO NORTHERN/CENTRAL IND TO NORTHWEST OH WITH THIS FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS. THIS MCS IS BEING MAINTAINED BY A FEED OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 2000-3000 J PER KG/ OVER THE SOUTHERN HALF OF IL/INDIANA AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET HAS VEERED TO WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY AND STRENGTHENED TO 40-45 KT. IN ADDITION... 700-MB WINDS HAVE VEERED TO WEST-NORTHWESTERLY /MORE PARALLEL TO STRONG 500-MB FLOW/ AND STRENGTHENED TO 40-45 KT. GIVEN THESE FACTORS...ESPECIALLY THE ALREADY FORMED INTENSE REAR-INFLOW JET...STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS UP TO AROUND 70 KT WILL BECOME LIKELY ACROSS CENTRAL INDIANA INTO SOUTHWEST OH FROM 05-08Z. ..PETERS.. 06/23/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE FROM SERN OH THROUGH WV THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. A WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED FOR THIS REGION BY 730Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING A LINE OF SEVERE STORMS EXTENDS FROM ACROSS SWRN OH MOVING SEWD AT 50 KT. DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS LINE STORMS CONTINUE WITHIN THE WARM ADVECTION ZONE ACROSS SERN OH INTO NRN/CNTRL WV. PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE WITH FAST MOVING LINE AS IT CONTINUES SEWD...SUPPORTED BY UNSTABLE INFLOW FROM A 50+ KT WSWLY LLJ. THERE IS ALSO SOME INDICATION THAT STORMS IN WARM ADVECTION ZONE ARE TRANSITIONING TO FORWARD PROPAGATING AND THESE WILL ALSO POSE A RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND AS WELL AS A TORNADO OR TWO.

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BROKEN LINE OF TRAINING STORMS EXTENDS FROM ECNTRL IND THROUGH SRN OH. THESE STORMS ARE DEVELOPING WITHIN ZONE OF STRONG MESOSCALE ASCENT RESULTING FROM A 50 KT WSWLY LLJ INTERACTING WITH THE ATTENDANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. INFLOW FROM THE MODERATELY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT/CONVERGENCE ALONG AND NORTH OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES SHOULD HELP TO SUSTAIN STORMS BEYOND 09Z...AND WIND PROFILES REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR UPDRAFT ROTATION AND OCCASIONAL BOWING SEGMENTS WITH DAMAGING WIND THE PRIMARY THREAT. HOWEVER...A SLOW BUT GRADUAL DECREASE IN OVERALL INTENSITIES IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE AS ACTIVITY DEVELOPS SEWD THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING. ..DIAL.. 06/23/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
